day_shape: Lavrov visits Tehran as Pezeshkian pushes multipolar line, Iran summons EU and German envoys, Houthis kill 18+ at Yemeni camp and claim strikes deep in Saudi Arabia, IMO warns Hormuz transit unsafe, and WFP cuts Gaza food aid to 500,000.

threads.label: Lavrov in Tehran, multipolar messaging
threads.summary: Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov was received in Tehran by Araghchi and met Pezeshkian and SNSC secretary Reza'i, with Iran's president framing cooperation around multilateralism and criticising US regional bases. China's premier separately met Iran's first vice president urging dialogue, and Araghchi held a call with Brazil's foreign minister.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz safety dispute
threads.summary: The IMO Secretary-General warned ship owners not to transit the Strait of Hormuz, citing attack levels back to conflict-onset highs, as reported by Iranian state outlets. Iranian officials including VP Arif, Mokhber, Araghchi and IRGC spokesman Mohebii asserted Iranian sovereignty over the strait and blamed the US for tensions.

threads.label: Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia and Yemen
threads.summary: Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree claimed six operations against Saudi targets including Aramco's Yanbu facility and the Shaybah oilfield, plus six ballistic missiles on the Al-Ilm Saudi military centre, with explosions reported in Najran. Separately, a Houthi attack on a Yemeni government training camp in Shabwa killed at least 18.

threads.label: Iran-EU diplomatic friction
threads.summary: Iran summoned the German ambassador over what Tasnim called 'baseless accusations', while Germany said it summoned Iran's envoy over an attempted attack on German Jewish community leaders. Tehran also summoned Ireland's ambassador as EU rotating chair over an EU leaders' statement, and Araghchi said Macron 'made his bed' siding with the US.

threads.label: IDF Gaza strikes and ceasefire enforcement
threads.summary: The IDF announced it killed a Hamas cell commander and two operatives in weekend strikes in Gaza City's Tuffah neighbourhood, naming weapons-production operative Abdullah Mohammed Khamis Jaber. It also published a captured Hamas engineering document said to detail plans to plant explosives around displaced-persons camps, and reported two apprehensions in Kafr Aqab.

threads.label: Gaza humanitarian cuts
threads.summary: The UN World Food Programme said funding shortages will cut monthly food support to about 500,000 people in Gaza, where two-thirds struggle to get enough to eat. Defa Press amplified Gaza authorities warning of the humanitarian consequences of the WFP stoppage.

threads.label: IRGC defiance and Khamenei sports messaging
threads.summary: Iran's armed forces chief General Abdollahi and IRGC spokesmen issued defiant statements, saying Iran will defend itself under any circumstances and that 'the world will see what will happen'. Khamenei's office issued three posts congratulating the under-23 freestyle wrestling world championship win, and OCHA reported September strikes in four southern provinces killed 18 and injured 142.

Why are they facing problems with petrol and gas and having problems with the supply of fertiliser and LPG? If the strait is open, they should be able to control these problems. Mokhber also described the threat of using "mother of all bombs" against Iran as "a joke".
